cdc_top  [clk_b]
├── u_src_a : ff  [clk_a]
├── u_src_c : ff  [clk_c]
├── u_sync : sync2  [clk_b]  ⚠CDC[clk_a→clk_b]
├── u_flagged : sync2  [clk_b]  ⚠CDC[clk_a→clk_b]
├── u_raw : ff  [clk_b]  ⚠CDC[clk_a→clk_b]
├── u_unchecked : sync2  [clk_b]  ⚠CDC[clk_a→clk_b]
├── u_mix : mix2  [clk_b]  ⚠CDC[clk_a→clk_b, clk_c→clk_b]
├── u_dual : mix2  [clk_b]  ⚠CDC[clk_a→clk_b, clk_c→clk_b]
└── u_bridge : bridge  [clk_a]
    ├── u_ab : sync2  [clk_b]  ⚠CDC[clk_a→clk_b]
    └── u_ba : sync2  [clk_a]  ⚠CDC[clk_b→clk_a]
